payingUser: A homeowner preparing a paint, tile, drywall, or flooring purchase from a real room measurement.
paidUnit: One permanent unlock of unlimited room plans, opening-aware material quantities, editable local prices, and PDF export.
momentOfPayment: After a free first-room preview shows its corrected geometry and material quantities, before the user creates a complete PDF material sheet.
distinctnessSentence: A homeowner can correct a sensor-assisted room trace, subtract openings, round paint, tile, drywall, flooring, and adhesive to purchasable packs, and export an offline PDF sheet in one workflow.
day1RevenuePath: A homeowner finds room measurement or floor-plan search, measures one room free, sees the material-plan preview, and buys the permanent unlock through Play Billing before PDF export.
